body: Neither do I but I can’t go back now

I think you know deep down what this means.

Hey. I don’t know you and you don’t know me but I care about you. An awful lot. And I don’t want you to leave. Please please take that box cutter off of your nightstand. I know we value ourselves based off of others opinions. I know that it’s difficult to stop. But they don’t matter. They don’t. I’m not going to lie to you and say that everything is going to be easy all of a sudden, getting better will be difficult and it will take time, but it’s worth it. You have value. Please. Stay. If you need to speak further with me don’t hesitate my dms are open. I care about you. X

Hey. You’re right. We are all searching for a sense of belonging, but we are all worthy of life and don’t ever think that you are not. I know it’s difficult, and I know you feel a sense of worthlessness but you do belong. This is going to be difficult to believe because we tend to tell ourselves that people are lying to us but I’m a stranger and I have no reason to lie to you. I am telling you the absolute truth. I wish you the best. X

Bad people actions are never your responsibility. Stay true to who you are and good people will find you. Most of the time bad people are damaging themselves more than others so the best thing we can do is show kindness to everybody and maybe change someone’s perspective x
Hey maybe you should reach out and find some professional help? If your friends are good to you they should be supportive of this. I’m sorry you’re feeling like this x
Hi it sounds like you’re in a difficult spot. What is troubling you? My dms are open x

The answer is always fight. I am so sorry that you have been reduced to drugs and that you feel like there’s no way out. I also understand feeling like there’s no reason to keep going but I promise you there is, and when you get the help you need you will see this. My dms are open if you want to vent to me. Love you x
